entries.claim: The pinned Latin Mass data independently corroborate the component's substantive Latin and expose accidental editorial variants for collation.

locator.section: RG 480–481, 511 d/i, 513–514; Ordo Missae rubric and chant formula after the secrets

entries.claim: The final secret has an audible Per omnia saecula saeculorum followed by the response Amen. Collects and postcommunions are priestly orations with a separate response. These rules determine the modeled boundaries, not the completeness of a date-specific commemoration inventory.

locator.section: Rubricae generales 115 a: Father-directed common conclusion

entries.claim: Rubricae generales 115 a prints the full twenty-one-word Per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum Filium tuum conclusion through per omnia saecula saeculorum and following Amen. It supports the supplied wording at w026–w046 and the separate w047 Amen after the proper page’s Per Dominum cue. Reader accents, ligatures, colon after tuum and uppercase Qui are declared editorial accidentals, not exact typography from this rubric. This use does not assign the response performer or prayer voice.

The cited page prints this prayer’s proper body and the abbreviated conclusion “Per Dóminum”. The full common conclusion and Amen are supplied separately in the reader, with its own accentuation, capitalization and punctuation.
